column1: # Echo-Cook partition table for the ESP32-P4-WIFI6 board (16 MB flash).
#  * "factory"- single OTA-less app slot at the stock ESP-IDF app offset 0x10000.
#              Keep the app FIRST and at 0x10000: the bootloader default
#              ESP-IDF flash_args and PlatformIO's merged firmware.factory.bin all
#              assume that offset. With the app anywhere else the merged image
#              and the board boot-loops ("invalid magic byte" /
#              "Factory app partition is not bootable"). Move to a two-OTA table
#              echo_wakeword/engines/tflite_engine.cpp looks this partition up by
#              name and falls back to an embedded blob only if it is absent
#              its offset is free to move.
